items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: This same fellow, I was telling you about, Williams, Bobby Williams from Louisville. Oh, yeah. Well, he was working with him at that time. They had a, they had a band that played, uh, all types of.

ctx.x: And we had a... Had a guy, uh... A... A... A... Very good entertainer, singer, with the band. Lockwood Lewis. He was... He was... He was very good. And, uh... Everywhere we'd go, we'd... We'd... Pretty... Pretty nice. And so I just... Just went from that and... And I began to like it, you know. I... I... I began to just, uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Stick with it, you know. And finally, this fellow was... Telling about... William. Bob Williams. He was a... Trumpet player. Man, he was very good. He was a good musician.…
